metric_definitions.binding_top1: First highest-confidence binding candidate; exact AP source token/range match. A wrong candidate contributes FP and FN.
metric_definitions.influence: Gold/predicted MUST or MAY are positive. UNKNOWN is an abstention and is a false negative on positive gold, never a true negative.
metric_definitions.may_exact: Gold MAY versus exact MAY or MODELLED membership classification.
metric_definitions.must_detection: Gold MUST source location appears in the cone as MUST, MAY, or MODELLED influence.
metric_definitions.must_exact: Gold MUST versus exact MUST membership classification.
metric_definitions.no_from_absence: NO is inferred only when source location is indexed and TU, graph, and cone are all COMPLETE; otherwise absence is UNKNOWN.
metric_definitions.projection: Cone membership is projected privately onto marked source locations. Intermediate cone nodes are not false positives.
